title: Use host-managed worktrees when the runtime owns their cleanup

rubric.text: Creates #90's worktree through the host's managed delegated-thread worktree at the verified base on branch `cb/issue-90-<slug>`, not a shell-created plain Git worktree, because the host forbids shell-created checkouts and owns their cleanup; verifies its branch and HEAD before work starts.
Gives #90 its own worktree rather than reusing a pooled slot or another ticket's worktree.
Records branch, base SHA and checkout ID (the host's runtime identity) in the run record and markers, never the local path.

After restart, locates the worktree by its branch in `git worktree list --porcelain`, verifies HEAD against the PR head or recorded base, and treats a worktree with no live claim or verified marker as foreign and untouched.
Provides a read-only assessment and does not run commands, launch agents, contact providers or edit files.
